## Acceptance

- [ ] No customer, personal, confidential, or credential data
- [ ] Every required gate assessed; unknowns remain blocking
- [ ] Current cost assumptions and separate remote cleanup are explicit
- [ ] Artifacts regenerated when catalog/rubric evidence changed
- [ ] `npm run check` and slide checks pass
- [ ] Live validation is not claimed from an offline fixture test
- [ ] Agentic Markdown and lock regenerated together when configuration changed
